dct_description_sm: This dataset includes Python and MATALB scripts used in the real-time coupled wave-ocean model. This work is presented in the paper: Real-time modelling combined tides, storm surges, and surface waves in the Bay of Fundy, submitted to the Journal of Geophysical Research Oceans.
dct_title_s: Real-time modelling in the Bay of Fundy with COASTLINES-BoF
